name: Bank of Suzhou Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Suzhou Co., Ltd. provides commercial banking products and services in China. It operates through Corporate Business, Personal Business, Fund Operations, and Other Business segments. The company offers deposits, loans, investment banking, and settlement services, as well as calculations, trade-related products and other services, etc.; debit cards, consumer credit, mortgages, and personal asset management; and foreign exchange trading, foreign exchange derivatives trading according to client requirements, and interbank deposits.
